posts.title: Welcome to your blog
posts.excerpt: This post came with the app, with one for each of Nevela's tutorials, so the blog has something on it the first time you open it.
posts.body:
This post came with the app, with one for each of Nevela's tutorials, so the blog has something on it the first time you open it. Delete them whenever you like.

Where posts are written

Sign in and open Posts in the dashboard, under Blog. A post has a title, an excerpt for the list, a picture and a body with headings, lists, links and quotes.

Drafts, publishing and scheduling

A post is not on the site until it is published. Until then it is a draft, and only people who sign in can see it.

  • Publish puts it on the site at once.
  • Unpublish takes it off again and keeps it as a draft.
  • Give it a date and time still to come and it is scheduled: it appears by itself when that time arrives.

Making it yours

The pages that show the blog were written once, into your own app, and are yours to change: lib/blog.ts for its title, its description and how many posts are on a page, and app/blog for the list and for a post's own page. The newest three are on the home page too, from components/marketing/latest-posts.tsx.

There is an RSS feed at /blog/feed.xml, and every published post is in the sitemap.
